text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's Crown Prince Sheikh Hamad bin Isa al-Khalifa receives Syrian Vice-President Abdul-Halim Khaddam.
- Labour and social affairs minister calls for an increase in wages of private sector employees.
- A one-day seminar aimed at boosting investment cooperation between the Middle East and Southeast Asian regions was held in Bahrain on Wednesday.
- Algeria seeks to join Bahrain-based Arab Investment Company.
- Bahrain Middle East Bank sets up a new firm named Oasis CBO Limited in the Cayman Islands.
